event.Description: DIN event code: DIN2 (oddball/target, independently detected) or DIN1 (standard/control, evaluated at the same channel's DIN2-derived latencies, not independently detected)

p3_window_start.Description: Start of the P3 search window, derived from a grand average pooled across a posterior ROI of channels closest to the anchor electrode (e.g. Pz). Same for DIN1 and DIN2 rows of a given channel.

p3_window_end.Description: End of the P3 search window

p3_latency.Description: For DIN2: latency of the largest-magnitude voltage within the P3 window, for this channel (sign not constrained). For DIN1: the SAME latency as this channel's DIN2 row (reused, not independently detected).

p3_amplitude.Description: For DIN2: signed voltage at p3_latency (largest absolute value within the P3 window). For DIN1: the DIN1 waveform's signed voltage AT the same p3_latency as the DIN2 row (not an independently detected peak).

zero_crossing_latency.Description: For DIN2: latency of the last zero-crossing (linearly interpolated) before the P3 peak, searched backward from the peak to stimulus onset (t=0); NaN if none found. For DIN1: the SAME crossing latency as this channel's DIN2 row (reused, not independently detected).

auc_uV_s.Description: For DIN2: trapezoidal-integration area under the curve between zero_crossing_latency and p3_latency. For DIN1: the same integration window (from the DIN2-derived crossing to the DIN2-derived peak latency), but integrating the DIN1 waveform's own values over that window. NaN if no crossing was found for the DIN2 row.

baseline_amplitude_uV.Description: Subject-level QC metric (same value repeated across all rows): mean of the POSITIVE-only samples of the grand average (pooled DIN2 ROI average) between epoch start and its own zero-crossing before the P3 peak. Only positive excursions are averaged (negative samples discarded) since a plain mean over all samples would cancel out to ~0 regardless of noise level, as the baseline oscillates around 0uV. NaN if no zero-crossing was found on the grand average, or if the baseline segment contains no positive samples.

p3_baseline_ratio.Description: Subject-level QC metric (same value repeated across all rows): the grand average's P3 peak amplitude divided by baseline_amplitude_uV. Higher values indicate a P3 peak that stands out more clearly above the pre-response baseline; low values suggest the P3 may not be reliably distinguishable from noise for this subject. NaN if baseline_amplitude_uV is NaN.

mmn_window_start.Description: Start of the mismatch negativity (MMN) search window, derived from the DIN2-minus-DIN1 grand difference wave pooled across a fronto-central ROI of channels closest to the anchor electrode (e.g. Fz). Same for DIN1 and DIN2 rows of a given channel. NaN if no DIN1 (control) events were found for this subject.

mmn_latency.Description: Latency of the largest-magnitude voltage within the MMN window on this channel's DIN2-minus-DIN1 DIFFERENCE wave (sign not constrained, since MMN morphology can be reduced or inverted away from the fronto-central ROI). Same value repeated on both the DIN1 and DIN2 rows for this channel, since MMN is a single per-channel quantity, not computed separately per event.

mmn_amplitude.Description: Signed voltage of the DIN2-minus-DIN1 difference wave at mmn_latency for this channel (classically negative). Same value repeated on both the DIN1 and DIN2 rows for this channel.
